content.intro: In this lesson, you will study exploring bootstrap documentation and examples and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: Exploring Bootstrap Documentation and Examples helps you decide how to introduce Bootstrap without confusing presentation styles with application behavior. Start from semantic HTML, add the framework deliberately, and verify the result in a browser.

content_blocks.run_instructions: Save the snippet as index.html and open it in a modern browser with internet access to the pinned Bootstrap 5.3.8 CDN. It is a visual preview, not a server-side application.

content_blocks.text: Use the pinned Bootstrap 5.3.x baseline, follow the official component documentation, and verify semantic HTML, responsive behavior, and keyboard access before reusing the pattern.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating exploring bootstrap documentation and examples as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.

common_mistakes.problem: Checking only the default viewport or happy path.
common_mistakes.why: Responsive changes and interaction states can reveal issues that are not visible in a single screenshot.
common_mistakes.fix: Repeat the task at a narrow and a wide viewport and include keyboard/error state checks where relevant.
